nodes.label: ADR 0022: Tenant Management Surface Scope
nodes.rationale: Plan E is platform-admin-only. Every endpoint gated behind requirePlatformAdmin() under /dashboard/platform-admin/* route prefix. Self-serve tenant management (owner-facing subscription management, own-tenant audit history, own-tenant data export, in-app cancellation) deferred to Plan F. Admin-mediated GDPR export within 30 days is compliant.
alternatives_rejected: Build platform-admin and tenant self-serve in parallel (doubles work)
Tenant-only Plan E (operationally can't run SaaS without admin surface)
Build admin surface but expose subset to tenants via RBAC (auth-model branching + security risk)
